en.headline: Legco to require research for non-binding motions from next year
en.dek: Legislative Council President Starry Lee said lawmakers must submit research findings and recommendations when raising motions without legislative effect, to make debates more evidence-based.
body: The Legislative Council will require lawmakers to submit relevant research findings and recommendations when they raise motions that have no legislative effect, starting next year.

Council President Starry Lee said the requirement will allow the government and the public to better understand the intent and rationale of the motions and help the public follow debates in the chamber more easily.
Lee expressed hope that the government, the chief executive and officials would take on board more views from lawmakers and step up exchanges, making discussions on public policy more evidence-based.
She made the remarks at a lunch banquet at the Legislative Council Complex attended by Chief Executive John Lee, Executive Council members and government officials.

zh.headline: 立法會明年起非立法效力議案須附研究
zh.dek: 立法會主席李慧瓊表示，議員提出無立法效力的議案時須提交研究結果及建議，讓政府及公眾更易理解意圖，促進以證據為本的討論。
body: 立法會明年起將要求議員在提出無立法效力的議案時，須提交相關研究結果及建議。
立法會主席李慧瓊表示，這項要求可讓政府及公眾更清楚了解議案的意圖及理據，亦有助公眾更容易跟進議會內的辯論。
她希望政府、行政長官及各官員能更充分採納議員意見，加強交流，令公共政策討論更以證據為本。
李慧瓊是在立法會綜合大樓舉行的午宴上作上述表示，行政長官李家超、行政會議成員及政府官員亦有出席。
